visual_events.description: In a single continuous exterior shot, the camera starts angled upward at the upper facade and arched entrance porch of a two-storey exposed red-brick building with a blue sign reading TAKSHASHILA (0.0s–2.0s). The camera moves backward and tilts slightly down (2.0s–7.5s) to reveal the entrance steps, dark stone masonry plinth, grey concrete shoe racks/benches with footwear on the steps, decorative brick jali openings and circular upper-floor openings on the left, wooden casement windows with stepped brick sunshades on the right, a solar street lamp pole entering on the left around 6.0s, and the unpaved reddish-brown earth yard with green trees on the right. From approximately 7.5s to 10.56s, the backward camera motion slows into a nearly stationary wide framing of the building exterior.
